# CodeMirror 5.65.21

Unmodified files from https://registry.npmjs.org/codemirror/-/codemirror-5.65.21.tgz
(source: https://github.com/codemirror/codemirror5/tree/5.65.21).

- `codemirror.js`, `codemirror.css`: `lib/`
- `sas.js`: `mode/sas/sas.js` (SAS mode by Jared Dean, SAS Institute)
- `dracula.css`: `theme/dracula.css` (upstream theme, including syntax colors)
- `LICENSE`: upstream MIT license

Vendored so both browser and desktop GUIs work offline. To update, copy the
same files from a pinned upstream release, keep the license, and verify SAS
highlighting, editing, selection execution, file opening, and resizing.
